mapper.insert: insert into setmeal (category_id, name, price, status, description, image, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user) values (#{categoryId}, #{name}, #{price}, #{status}, #{description}, #{image}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{createUser}, #{updateUser})
mapper.select: select setmeal.id as id, setmeal.category_id as categoryId, setmeal.name as name, setmeal.price as price, setmeal.status as status, setmeal.description as description, setmeal.image as image, setmeal.update_time as updateTime, category.name as categoryName from setmeal left join category on setmeal.category_id = category.id
